# [3.4.0-dev.2](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/compare/v3.4.0-dev.1...v3.4.0-dev.2) (2025-01-31)

> [!NOTE]  
> Should I close this project? Should I leave? Am I even needed here? What's my purpose? Am I in the right place? Am I with the right people?
>
> Sometimes it feels like life gets harder, losing its vibrancy and luster. It's like sadness and frustration fill everything. Everything we do, everything we create, seems pointless, and everything becomes void. Everything grows faded and dull, almost as if you're becoming... gray yourself. I bet we all have these thoughts sometimes.
>
> But to make this life more saturated, you can now see a glimmer on the horizon of your interface with color indicators in the RVX settings. And if the standard options leave you green with envy, then prepare to be tickled pink by our secret weapon: the color picker!
> 
> Click that little indicator within each color setting and unlock a hue-niverse of possibilities. You're going to be hue-morously surprised. We're talking about a palette so vast, it would make a chameleon blush with jealousy. It's like a color wheel decided to have a rave, and everyone's invited! Ditch the 50 shades of "meh" and inject some serious saturation back into your digital life. It's time to add a little hue-manity back into your world! Just be careful not to get lost in the spectrum!

### Features

* **YouTube - Seekbar components:** Add a color indicator and a color picker to improve color settings ([bd0aa09](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/commit/bd0aa09ce0f0bace411122544c5565ff86e27f58))
